data_source.description: Frequencies derived from 3 months of HCP job exports (Apr 13 - Jul 6, 2026), 996 jobs across 160 unique customers. Tag values pulled from HCP Customer tags column. Observed values computed from average days between visits.

classification_rules.Commercial: has "Commercial" in HCP tags (overrides gap-based classification)
classification_rules.Unknown (1 visit): only 1 visit in observation window — could be new, one-off, or paused

global_notes: For all scheduling continuity decisions, prefer keeping the same primary cleaner across visits. Weekly and Bi-weekly clients have the highest disruption cost. Mismatches between tagged and observed frequency should be reviewed with Karen and resolved in HCP.
